name: Coastal Credit Union Music Park at Walnut Creek

bagPolicy.summary: Clear plastic, vinyl or PVC bags up to 12 × 6 × 12 inches and clutches up to 6 × 9 inches are permitted after search.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Nine lots surround the venue; a parking pass is required per car. General parking costs $20 online in advance or $25 on event day; lot opening depends on the show.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: Pickup and drop-off use Walnut Creek Athletic Complex, 1007 Birch Ridge Drive; tell the driver to enter Birch Ridge Drive.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Food and drinks are sold onsite. Guests may bring food in a clear one-gallon bag and up to one gallon of water in a sealed or empty bottle; outside alcohol is prohibited.
allowed: Sealed or empty water bottle up to one gallon
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Accessible parking is reached from the Rock Quarry entrance in lanes 2 or 3 and requires a disability placard or plate.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: Guests who leave cannot re-enter without another ticket.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: The amphitheater FAQ does not give a specific will-call pickup procedure for concerts.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Fast Lane operates at Gates 1 and 2 but does not admit before the posted door time. Gates usually open about one hour before the concert, subject to the event page.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
